header: Install, seed and theme in three steps

items.content: Install. Add webconsulting/desiderio to a TYPO3 v14.3 project with Composer. The package brings 244 content elements, 62 components and the theme layer. It is GPL-licensed and needs no licence key.
Seed. Run desiderio:styleguide:seed to create a complete demo site. It is safe in workspaces, and you can run it again after each upgrade without creating duplicates.
Theme. Choose one of 15 theme presets in the site settings, or give parts of the page tree their own. Colours, radius and fonts change everywhere at once.
